purpose: Only lower and upper physical outer faces constrained; all skin/core interior nodes free. Test real load transmission rather than imposed internal strains. Preserve A30 geometry, volume,density,LAW12/LAW28 and perfect-bond hypothesis, unchanged whole aircraft.

geometry.faces: identical node IDs at z=-4 and z=4, no duplicate interface masses, rigid-body offset or independent rotations

core.law: unchanged source LAW28/28 and constant plateau curves280..285
core.property: TYPE6 Isolid14 Ismstr4 Icpre3 Gauss222 Iframe2, same scalar property inputs as cached A20 core

loading.top_face: z=4.5: XYZprescribed, one component delta*s, other two0
loading.amplitude_reason: nominal displacement/thickness=.001, low elastic regime; source material/yield estimates, not a native response fit
loading.duration_reason: more than7transits over10mm at weakest source-core in-plane wave speed sqrt(E11/rho)≈144mm/ms. Quasi-static adequacy tested, not presumed.

independent_reference.method: heterogeneous small-strain conventional8node finite elements,2x2x2Gauss; source3Dtensors, same physical geometry and face boundary conditions; positive-Jacobian,symmetry,equilibrium,virtual-work checks
independent_reference.iterative_solver: matrix-free Jacobi-preconditioned CG, relative norm1e-10+absolute1e-11N,12000iterations max

native_reaction_protocol.observation: same binary A20REACcomponents act as accumulated nodal impulses, contrary to force label; verify summed raw values against physical momentum before differentiating
native_reaction_protocol.units: raw g*mm/ms toNs factor1e-3; d(raw)/d(time_ms) gives N; subtract prescribed top nodal inertia to recover internal static traction

acceptance.reaction_window: max error in final10% of ramp, divide by ramp amplitude

qualification: fineN12candidate requires every original mode gate plus spatial/time convergence and native field audit. Coarse failed gates retained separately, never rewritten. Perfect bond and unmeasured materials remain hypotheses.
